cohort: The study included 794 women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) at Fujian Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital from 2016 to 2018.
finding: The hematocrit-to-albumin ratio (HCT-ALB) was identified as an independent risk factor for severe maternal morbidity (SMM), with its predictive value improving when combined with other clinical indicators.
